items.why: CNBC reports Tesla and Musk's SpaceX are reviving the tech rally, lifting Nasdaq sentiment this morning.
Riding the broader tech rally as Tesla news lifts Nasdaq futures and risk appetite early in the session.
Fear gauge sliding as the Nasdaq tech rally and upbeat earnings coverage pull investors back toward risk.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Nasdaq futures up about 0.6% at the open with the VIX easing, a risk-on start.
summary: Tech is leading the morning, with the Nasdaq climbing on a Musk-driven rally while the VIX fades. Netflix's weak outlook is the caution flag on an otherwise upbeat tape.
